procedure_name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) Free LPG Connection
summary: Deposit-free LPG cylinder connection, free stove, and initial refill for adult women from poor households.

steps.title: Eligibility check for female adult
steps.description: Applicant must be an adult woman belonging to BPL/SC/ST/Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana household.

steps.title: Submit application at nearest gas distributor
steps.description: Apply on PMUY portal or submit form at nearest Indane, Bharat Gas, or HP Gas dealership.

steps.title: De-duplication check by OMC
steps.description: Oil Marketing Company cross-verifies database to ensure household has no existing LPG connection.

steps.title: Collection of cylinder and stove
steps.description: Dealer supplies free 14.2 kg LPG cylinder, regulator, safety rubber hose, and domestic gas stove.

steps.title: Targeted cylinder subsidy
steps.description: Receive ongoing government targeted subsidy credited directly to bank account on future refills.
